items.title: Migrating from Apache Hudi-based data lake to Apache Iceberg-based data lake
items.summary: Learn how to migrate transactional data lakes from Apache Hudi to Apache Iceberg on AWS. This post walks through in-place migration with the Iceberg add_files procedure and Apache XTable, plus full table migration with CTAS and INSERT, using AWS Glue notebooks and Amazon S3 Tables, then validates the results in Amazon Athena.
items.creator: Nitin Kumar
